---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a calculator workflow, compatibility, profile, or desktop experience improvement.
title: ""
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

# What are you trying to do?

Describe the player-visible or calculator-visible goal.

# Profile and generation

Name the affected ROM hack, canonical generation, or cross-generation workflow.

# Why is this useful?

Describe the calculation, team-building, trainer-data, save-import, or desktop use case.

# Desired workflow

Explain how the feature should work from opening KM Calculator through seeing or exporting the result.

# Public references

Link relevant public documentation, research, or repositories. Clearly label confirmed behavior and guesses, and include license or permission information for anything proposed for bundling.

# Extra context

Screenshots, focused mockups, and small synthetic examples are welcome. Redact local paths, account names, notifications, and private data.

# File safety

Do not attach ROMs, game dumps, console keys, executable game files, copyrighted assets, private saves, credentials, signing material, personal data, complete generated mods, or private trainer research.
